headline: US Thanksgiving Gasoline Prices Projected to Reach Record Levels
summary: Despite a 60-cent drop over the past month to $3.69 per gallon, US Thanksgiving gasoline prices may break holiday records. GasBuddy forecasts national averages will hit $3.62 per gallon on Thanksgiving Day.
why: US retail fuel prices impact consumer discretionary spending and broader CPI inflation figures.

impacts.name: US Gasoline
impacts.why: Seasonal holiday travel demand maintains retail pump pricing near historical highs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
